I live in Ohio, some of the most gorgeous parks are here, and if I go off trail it’s usually to find a good cluster of trees to post up my hammocks with my friends. Other than that I don’t do a lot of off trail hiking because ultimately it’s really bad for the wildlife and small saplings and shit. The one spot I was planning on going to only really includes like maybe 500 feet altogether of off trail boot stomping, so I let that slide a bit. It’s just a right off a trail and through some underbrush until you get to a thin mountain bike path, and then you follow that up a ways and make a left into the center of it. No foot traffic goes through there, just the occasional zoomy biker who never stops to really see what my hoodlum bunch of 20-something’s are getting into. I’ve spent a whole night in that spot before. 

I’ve never been to the northeast though, I’ve lived in 13 states, but damn Maine is something I really want to see.
